name: exam-start-seal
intent: A locked exam panel unlocks when its central seal cracks and halves split outward, revealing an active timed surface.

copy.hintIdle: Press Run to break the seal and begin.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Panel appears already ACTIVE with timer running; seal hidden

acceptance: Phases crackMs 160 → splitMs 260 (±42px halves) → activateMs 180 into ACTIVE surface
Seal break is split translate/rotate — not opacity fade as primary
Timer starts only on ACTIVE; reduced motion shows unlocked surface immediately
